Raspberry Pi 5 Snap Case (mit Power-Knopf)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/402551-raspberry-pi-5-snap-case-with-power-button?from=search#profileId-304587

I modified Malolo's snap case for the Raspberry Pi 3 on Thingiverse to fit the Raspberry Pi 5, and added power button compatibility built into the case. I also made it a hex pattern for better ventilation.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 3 walls, 100% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 3
- Infill: 100%
- Filament: PLA (#00AE42)
